plan.comment: 1. Letters (comms/mail/mailroom/<member>/conductor__NNN-*.eml, outbox copies): to every member, the conductor's new session id and key; to the researcher and publisher, the four Leanpub studies; to the publisher, L1's reasoning (LEANPUB.md stays the publisher's). 2. team/conductor/: a sessions register (old session to new, per member) and the four Leanpub studies from web-research sub-agents in research/leanpub/ (material, cited). 3. book.json: H1's detail in the editor's words, left open for his signature; L1 (already decided) gains his reasoning for the $0 minimum, its decision unchanged. vault_check, build, validate, push to dev.

pre_review.comment: Within scope. Conditions: letters carry only public key and session id; the studies go as cited material for the researcher and publisher to judge, nothing in their folders or LEANPUB.md; no private person's contact details in research/leanpub/ (public authors and book pages only); H1 stays open with the editor's words quoted; L1's decision unchanged, only reasoning added; vault_check on comms; no em-dashes; nothing to the blind repository.
